sandbachFocus: Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. The league leaders sit top with 22 points from 10 games despite that defeat, and face a struggling Alsager side currently bottom of the table with just 4 points. Sandbach then travel to face Cheadle Heath Nomads on Saturday 10 October at 15:00 in their second fixture of the week.
divisionWide: The division's top sides face different challenges this weekend: Stafford Town host Dawley Town, while AFC Bridgnorth travel to Eccleshall in a clash between 3rd and 5th place teams. Wolverhampton Casuals visit Wednesfield Community in another top-half encounter. The struggling bottom sides provide competitive tests across the board—Widnes Town are away at Brereton Social, Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Sandbach's next opponent, and Telford Town travel to face New Mills. Shawbury United, on a six-game losing streak, host Barnton at home on 10 October, desperately needing a positive result. Other midweek action sees Brereton Social entertain Wednesfield Community on Wednesday 7 October. On 10 October, Bilston Town welcome Crewe, Market Drayton Town host Widnes Town, and Allscott Heath travel to face Brereton Social seeking to extend their impressive recent form.
